summary: Magic amulet with +3 Projectile Skills: Greater Essence of Opulence, prefix desecration as a fracture blocker, then a 1-in-3 Fracturing Orb to fracture the +3.

steps: Buy a magic amulet with +3 Projectile Skills, 15 div (17 the next day); open-prefix bases cost more, a filled prefix is acceptable; base name not stated, Gold Amulet assumed (he calls gold bases the best)
Perfect Orb of Augmentation only if the prefix is open (hit spell damage)
Greater Essence of Opulence guarantees rarity and makes it rare
Omen of Sinistral Necromancy + Preserved Collarbone: a desecrated prefix, which the Fracturing Orb cannot hit
Fracturing Orb (~1-1.5 div): 1 in 3 to fracture the +3; hit 2 of 3 in the video, 'missed seven in a row' the night before
Per success = 3 attempts at the stated 1-in-3 (each attempt is one base; the harness counts baseDiv once); misses continue as a catalysed finish not costed here
Fractured +3 projectile + rarity amulets 'selling for 60 divine' (earlier 'worth like 40 div')
